subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Read each informational passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

The heart's four chambers pump blood.

How many chambers?
A) Two
B) Four
C) Six

Read.

The author argues cities should plant more trees.

Purpose:
A) persuade
B) entertain
C) confuse

'As a scientist of 30 years, I assure you...' appeals to:
A) ethos (credibility)
B) pathos only
C) rhyme

Read.

The printing revolution spread knowledge and literacy, but also propaganda and conflict.

The central idea is that it spread:
A) only good things
B) both knowledge and conflict
C) nothing new

'Ask not what your country can do for you' gains its power from a:
A) reversal (antithesis) for emphasis
B) statistic
C) definition

Read.

The printing press made books cheaper and spread literacy.

An effect was:
A) fewer readers
B) more literacy
C) no change

Read.

'Either we act now or we lose everything.'

This reasoning is weak because it is a:
A) false dilemma (ignores other options)
B) valid statistic
C) relevant study

steps: Only two options. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Wetlands cover a small area yet filter water, prevent floods, and shelter countless species; many are being drained.

Which is BEST supported?
A) Protecting wetlands protects many valuable functions
B) Wetlands are useless
C) Wetlands cause floods
items.answer: A) Protecting wetlands protects many valuable functions

solution.answer: A) Protecting wetlands protects many valuable functions
